blocks.text: An observable sends values to a subscriber. of makes a stream from the values you give it.
Use a JavaScript or TypeScript project with RxJS 7 installed. Run imports through the project tool. Browser event examples need the stated HTML element. This site does not include RxJS in its runner.
Read the code step by step

items: `of` emits the supplied values in order and then completes. This example does not wait between those values.
`subscribe` registers a listener. For a stream or store that stays active, keep and use its cleanup handle.

blocks.text: The console prints 2, then 4, then 6. This stream then completes.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Subscribing is how you start listening. Not every observable starts work before someone subscribes.
